first_prompt: The following is the Codex agent history added since your last approval assessment. Continue the same review conversation. Treat the transcript delta, tool call arguments, tool results, retry reason,

commits.summary: Freeze the domain foundations baseline (verification pending)
commits.body:
Bound the historical campaign to its original classpaths, JVM counterexample replays and raw job receipts. Preserve the six-PR and transfer populations, and preselect receiver examples from different libraries before changing the verifier. The archived scorecard recount passed at 39/46 original native outcomes, all five ambient replay digests matched, both changed test groups passed and the job schema validated.

Jobs 20261121-232059-domain-foundations-355-ordinary-and-obse and 20261121-232059-domain-foundations-360-ordinary-and-obse repeat strict startup checks on the post-architecture head. Jobs 20261121-232059-domain-foundations-354-larger-unsplit-di and 20261121-232059-domain-foundations-359-larger-unsplit-di measure one 180-second unsplit query per historical timeout at unchanged bounds.

commits.summary: Pin the original Avro decimal upgrade (verification pending)
commits.body:
Register Avro #729 as a separate adoption cohort. Pin its first-parent pair, nested DecimalConversion class, original Maven build and landed JUnit method without widening the original campaign population. Checked both historical source and test blobs in the upstream Git repository, the original first-parent link, the six plus two frozen populations, four runner tests, and the job schema.

Job 20261121-232627-build-avro-729-decimal-conversion-on-bot builds both original modules and runs the landed decimal test on each. Their verified artifact receipts will make the frozen public example executable.

commits.summary: Trace startup dependencies on original JVMs (verification pending)
commits.body:
Pair each ordinary JVM call with a nontransforming JVMTI observer on the same checked Maven JARs. Record static and selected receiver reads and writes by method and bytecode offset, actual class status and unbound classes. Inspect class bytes offline to distinguish static declarations and candidate writers from the paths that actually ran. Include CPU, directory, resource, separator, changed-observer and throwing-initializer controls.

On Temurin 21.0.13 the Avro writer-schema observer returned BYTES and the identical object twice. The JavaParser separator observer returned LF, failed at initialization after the property was cleared, and failed again with an erroneous class. Instrumented and ordinary JVM outputs matched. The static scanner checked instruction offsets against the original classfile labels and lengths, including 180 Avro-path classes in the smoke test. Both jobs validated. Jobs 20261121-233322-trace-original-startup-and-field-depende and 20261121-233332-trace-javaparser-field-and-property-depe run the full profile matrix on both revisions.

commits.summary: Freeze Avro decimal cursor and result claims (verification pending)
commits.body:
Example 361 exercises the public DecimalConversion.fromBytes twice on the same buffer. Twelve original windows include signed values, nonzero positions, prefix and suffix bytes, and two scales. A separate Python big-endian oracle checks cursor, both unscaled integers and both scales. The parent consumed every window and the second conversion raised NumberFormatException. The fixed bytecode preserved every window and matched all expected values.

Verified both complete Maven build receipts and the named upstream JUnit failure and pass. All three wrong-result controls were rejected. All five tasks planned, both sides replayed on Temurin 21, the example validator passed and all 32 selected test groups passed. Job 20261121-233929-check-the-prepared-avro-729-baseline-on measures the frozen native and finite claims on these products. It supersedes 20261121-233611-baseline-the-frozen-avro-729-cursor-and, announced before the example landed.

commits.summary: Restore the frozen receiver cohort (verification pending)
commits.body: The earlier run removed its temporary caller trees after recording the results. Reuse the serial public-source acquisition and validate the original selected caller blob under each old and new revision. Exercise the first-parent and source-byte checks on the historical Avro repository. Job 20261121-234853-restore-the-original-receiver-cohort-bef validates all 32 previously selected pairs before the native rescore.

commits.summary: Prove independent cursors for duplicate heap buffers (verification pending)
commits.body:
On an exact heap buffer the native checker now runs the selected JDK duplicate, markValue and session bytecode. The new buffer shares the same array and inherits the mark, position, limit and capacity, while reads and position changes remain local. The existing boundary on foreign sessions still applies. A strict probe established the duplicate and bulk-read contract on symbolic bytes up to length six and all valid windows. The previous checker refused duplicate. A deliberately shared-cursor assertion was refuted, both Temurin 21 and 25 passed the focused regression, and all 49 selected test groups passed.

The domain pilot binds actual historical wrap operands and the identity of the returned buffer entering decimal conversion. Job 20261121-234701-qualify-bounded-heap-buffer-facts-across measures fresh and reused proofs with current JDK, model, bounds and call-site validation. The two-PR smoke tests observed all 21 writable inputs and all 12 decimal inputs. Collected and digest-checked the earlier startup, upstream build and single-query comparison results. Both larger unsplit queries established their original claims. The ordinary Avro and JavaParser startup refusals and the premature decimal job remain recorded.

commits.summary: Rebuild the original receiver classpaths (verification pending)
commits.body:
All 32 original source pairs were recovered across 28 repositories. Hash-checked the collector receipt and all selected caller blobs. Reuse the historical build phase and dependency scopes for the 18 complete-module callers, with the shared serial Maven cache. The remaining 14 use their original source slice recipes. The seven groups have disjoint case sets and all job files validated.

Jobs 20261121-235615-rebuild-receiver-cohort-group-01-on-its through 20261121-235615-rebuild-receiver-cohort-group-07-on-its reproduce the original complete-module operands before the native receiver rescore.
